page.overview:
Who is Kurt Reed?

Kurt Reed is the head of InGen's Special Ops and the main antagonist in Jurassic World: Live Tour.

He meets his demise in the climax of the Jurassic World: Live Tour. He is chased off the stage by Blue and Rexy. We hear the T. rex roar and Reed's scream.
